history.summary: Uncertain identity - thin placeholder. The Telangana government's Revenue (Endowments) Department records a 'Sri Ram Mandhir Temple, Jagitial Town & District' and constituted a 14-member Renovation Committee for it (G.O.Rt.No.168, 20-04-2021; term extended one year by G.O.Rt.No.313, 30-07-2021), which is the strongest evidence for the local Rama temple in Jagtial town that this row likely refers to. 'Sri Ramalayam' may be the same shrine under a variant name, but this is unconfirmed from published sources. No reliable published history, founding date, festival or timing details were found. Coordinates are Jagtial town centre - exact temple location unverified. CSV 'state' column held the district/town name; actual state is Telangana.

name: Sri Ramalayam
town_description: Jagtial (Jagitial) is a town and district headquarters in northern Telangana, about 190 km from Hyderabad. It is a regional trade centre for the surrounding agricultural area, close to the Godavari river towns of Dharmapuri and the Kondagattu Anjaneya Swamy temple.

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad (~190 km; verify)
travel.road: By road from Hyderabad via Karimnagar (~190 km; verify)
